description: This file defines the class 'RelatedModuleMeta' which manages metadata about relationships between modules in the vtiger CRM, including identifying relation types and related database table structures.

classes.name: RelatedModuleMeta
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the relationship metadata between two modules, providing methods to retrieve relationship info based on predefined relation types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the source and related module names, enforcing creation via getInstance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a RelatedModuleMeta object for specified modules.

methods.name: getRelationMeta
methods.description: Returns relationship metadata (such as relation table and key columns) based on module pairs.

methods.name: getRelationMetaInfo
methods.description: Private method to retrieve specific relationship table and columns based on a relation ID.
